lead_raw_text:
The structure of Mg2Pd crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Pnma (No. 62), with a unit cell containing 12 atoms (Mg8Pd4) and three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis shows both Mg and Pd centers in close-packed-like local arrangements with 12 geometric neighbors each; Mg environments include mixed Mg/Pd and Pd-only coordination, while Pd is surrounded by 12 Mg neighbors. The geometric neighbor graph is fully connected in three dimensions, and validated polyhedron-sharing relations reveal corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among the 12-vertex Mg and Pd coordination polyhedra.
